goalZh: 会打电话报修:说明来意、描述问题、报房间号、约维修时间
canDoZh: 能打电话报修:说清楚哪里出了问题,约好维修的时间

newItems.noteZh: ea 是长元音 /iː/,t 读闪音:"HEE-der";space heater 是电暖器。
make a noise 发出响声(不说 do a noise);结尾 se 读 /z/,要带声。
str 中间不加元音(复习第 5 单元);a 读 /eɪ/,结尾 ge 读 /dʒ/。
in the middle of the night 半夜里;in the middle 在中间;结尾的 le 读成音节 /əl/。
宿舍、公寓的维修部门就叫 Maintenance;重音在前 MAIN-te-nance。
What's your room number? 你房间号是多少?;312 读 three twelve。
a worker 一个(维修)工人;wor 读 /wɝː/,卷舌。
A worker can come by tomorrow. 明天会有工人过来;by 重读。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Ethan, are you awake? Listen to the heater!
lines.zh: (查房前两天的半夜)伊森,你醒着吗?听听这暖气!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: I know! It makes a strange noise in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: 我知道!一到半夜它就发出怪声。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Call maintenance. They answer at night.
lines.zh: 给维修部打电话吧,晚上也有人接。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Hi. I'm calling about my heater. There's a problem with it.
lines.zh: 您好。我打电话是为了暖气的事,它出了点问题。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: It makes a loud noise, and the room is really cold.
lines.zh: 它响声很大,而且房间里特别冷。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: I'm sorry. What's your room number?
lines.zh: 真抱歉。你的房间号是多少?

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: A worker can come by tomorrow morning. Is that OK?
lines.zh: 明天上午会有工人过去,可以吗?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes. I'm at home tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Great. For tonight, wear a warm sweater!
lines.zh: 好的。今晚先穿件暖和的毛衣吧!

questions.explainZh: It makes a loud noise, and the room is really cold.——响声很大,屋里也很冷。
What's your room number? —— Room 312.——312 读 three twelve。
A worker can come by tomorrow morning.——明天上午,磊说他那时在家。

grammar.titleZh: 打电话报修:说清楚哪儿出了问题
grammar.bodyZh: 报修先说来意:I'm calling about my heater.(我打电话是为了暖气的事);再说问题:There's a problem with it. / It makes a loud noise. / It's broken.(第 6 单元)/ The room is really cold.。对方常问 What's the problem? 和 What's your room number?;约时间时对方会问 Is that OK?,方便就说 Yes. I'm at home tomorrow morning.。make a noise 是固定搭配(发出响声),不说 do a noise。

examples.zh: 我打电话是为了暖气的事。

examples.text: There's a problem with it. It makes a loud noise.
examples.zh: 它出了点问题,响声很大。

examples.text: A worker can come by tomorrow morning. Is that OK?
examples.zh: 明天上午会有工人过去,可以吗?

grammar.titleZh: 发音:heater 的长元音和闪音 t
grammar.bodyZh: heater 读 /ˈhiːt̬ɚ/:ea 是长元音 /iː/,嘴角往两边拉;中间的 t 在两个元音之间读成闪音,像轻快的 d:"HEE-der",和 water、tutor 一样。别和 hitter /ˈhɪt̬ɚ/ 混——那是短元音 /ɪ/。noise /nɔɪz/ 的结尾是浊音 /z/,要带声。
